approval_text_summary: Explicit approval is given to place paper trades and sell during and after market hours. Veritas may get an order from the advisor surface and notify the main session with a capital package notification. Reminders and crons should reflect this position.
allowed_actions_under_guard: submit scoped paper buy order through WF67 wrapper
submit scoped paper sell order through WF67 wrapper
cancel scoped paper order through WF67 wrapper
notify main session with capital package status
required_before_paper_submit_or_sell: advisor or capital packet source artifact
exact scoped paper-trade request artifact naming ticker, side, quantity/notional, order type, time-in-force, rationale, and risk check
fresh short-lived WF67 kill switch enabling paper submit/cancel only
WF67 guard validation status ok with 0 critical / 0 warning or explicitly accepted non-safety warning
main-session capital package notification before or immediately with execution result

allowed_order_scope.submission_window: during or after market hours is allowed for paper orders; execution/fill behavior is whatever Alpaca paper accepts for the order terms

blocked_scope: short sales unless separately scoped and validated
margin, leverage, options, crypto, multi-leg/bracket/OCO/OTO orders
promotion of paper results to live deployment
owner approval inferred from score, alert, validation, packet quality, or paper fill
notes: This artifact widens standing paper-only authority for advisor-derived buy/sell packages, but does not authorize live execution or remove WF67 wrapper/kill-switch/validator/audit requirements.
